readme.run: Correct the bias field with ANTs N4 inside a MindGrab brain mask
notes: Runs the web app's correction (the same ANTs N4 WebAssembly module) with the
MRtrix dwibiascorrect ants options (-s 4 -b [100,3] -c [1000,0.0]). A 3D image
is corrected directly; for a DWI the field is fitted to the mean b0 and divided
out of every volume. It writes the corrected image, the bias field and the
brain mask. The .bval, .bvec and .json beside the image with the same name are
passed through under the output's name; --bval, --bvec and --json name others.
MindGrab runs on the CPU and needs about 2.6 GB of memory. Give --mask FILE to
use your own brain mask. Add --help for every setting.
No network connection is required. Input is NIfTI only: convert DICOM with
dcm2niix first, or use the web app.
Please cite: Tustison NJ, Avants BB, Cook PA, Zheng Y, Egan A, Yushkevich PA,
Gee JC. N4ITK: improved N3 bias correction. IEEE Trans Med Imaging.
